question: Which product category grew the most in 2025?
why: Growth in USD or in percent, against 2024.

interpretations.label: Largest growth in USD
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, round(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01') - sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_on < DATE '2025-01-01'), 2) AS growth_usd FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN sales.products p USING (product_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY growth_usd DESC LIMIT 1

interpretations.label: Largest growth in percent
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, round(100 * (sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_on >= DATE '2025-01-01') / sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) FILTER (WHERE o.ordered_on < DATE '2025-01-01') - 1), 1) AS growth_pct FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN sales.products p USING (product_id) WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY growth_pct DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which country is our largest market?
why: Largest by revenue, or by number of completed orders (2024 and 2025).

interpretations.label: Most revenue
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT co.name AS country, round(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN sales.countries co ON co.country_code = c.country_code WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY co.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

interpretations.label: Most completed orders
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT co.name AS country, count(*) AS orders FROM sales.orders o JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN sales.countries co ON co.country_code = c.country_code WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY co.name ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which customer segment is the most valuable?
why: Most total revenue, or most revenue per customer (2024 and 2025).

interpretations.label: Most total revenue
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT c.segment, round(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)), 2) AS revenue FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

interpretations.label: Most revenue per customer
interpretations.reference_sql: SELECT c.segment, round(sum(l.quantity * l.unit_price * (1 - l.discount_pct / 100)) / count(DISTINCT c.customer_id), 2) AS revenue_per_customer FROM sales.order_lines l JOIN sales.orders o USING (order_id) JOIN sales.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY revenue_per_customer DESC LIMIT 1
